[Section] Maximum Entropy (ME)
[source_id=40] Maximum Entropy theory is applied to solve Vietnamese word segmentation BIBREF15 , BIBREF22 , BIBREF23 . Some researchers do not want the limit in Markov chain model. So, they use the context around of the word needed to be segmented. Let h is a context, w is a list of words and t is a list of taggers, Le BIBREF15 , BIBREF22 used DISPLAYFORM0
[source_id=41] P(s) is also a product of probabilities of words created from sentence INLINEFORM0 (1). Each conditional probability of word is based on context h of the last n word in the sentence s.
